SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND ss.NumTstTakr > 500;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.NCESDist,
    s.CharterNum,
    s.OpenDate,
    s.ClosedDate
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE 
    s.Magnet = 1
    AND sa.NumTstTakr > 500;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND s.NumTstTakr > 500;

SELECT s.School, s.Magnet, s.EILName, s.GSoffered
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.NumTstTakr > 500 AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR s.EILName LIKE '%Magnet%' OR s.GSoffered LIKE '%Magnet%');

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = SUBSTR(sat.cds, 1, 12)
WHERE sat.NumTstTakr > 500 AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR s.EILCode LIKE '%MAGNET%');

SELECT DISTINCT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = REPLACE(st.cds, ' ', '')
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 500 AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR s.MagnetProgram IS NOT NULL);

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
WHERE sa.NumTstTakr > 500 AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR s.Charter = 1);

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores st ON s.School = st.sname
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 500 AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR s.Charter = 1);

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.NumTstTakr >= 500 AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.NumTstTakr >= 500 AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND ss.NumTstTakr >= 500;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 OR s.Charter = 1
AND f.`2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status` = 1
AND s.NumTstTakr > 500;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.School_Code
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND f.`2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status` = 1 AND s.NumTstTakr > 500;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.School_Code
WHERE s.Magnet = 1 OR s.Charter = 1 AND f.`2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status` = 1 AND s.NumTstTakr > 500;

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.NumTstTakr > 500 AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR s.EILName LIKE '%Magnet%');
